name: Medical Non-production for Clinic Appointments
description: This dataset records reasons clinic appointments were not kept at correctional facilities, broken down by year, facility, and court. Each row represents a combination of year, facility, and court, with counts for scheduled appointments and various categories of non-production: refusals, walkouts, programming, barbershop, recreation, and other reasons, plus a total scheduled figure. The data covers 277 sampled rows across 11 columns, with 10 facilities and 179 courts represented. It can be used to compare missed-appointment patterns across facilities and courts, identify which non-production reasons dominate, and track changes over time. Analysts could use it to allocate clinic resources, investigate high refusal or walkout rates, or evaluate scheduling efficiency in correctional health settings.
